==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the day)
:'''Wulü:''' Hi there! You don't seem like a local. If you need any help, just let me know, and I'll be happy to assist!
:{{DIcon}} I'm looking for food...
::'''Wulü:''' What do you like to eat? Stir-fry, hot pot, or something fried?
::'''Wulü:''' In that case, I recommend [[Panhua]]'s Restaurant. Miss Panhua's dishes never disappoint!
:{{DIcon}} I'm looking for souvenirs...
::'''Wulü:''' Looking for souvenirs? Check with [[Ganxue]]. The [[Pioneer Association]] has a lot of new merchandise!
::'''Wulü:''' They have all sorts of badges, cards, tickets, and more. My daughter loves them!
:{{DIcon}} I have some little boxes with me...
::'''Wulü:''' Little box? Oh, you mean a [[Sonance Casket]], right?
::'''Wulü:''' I understand that [[Chenpi]] likes these gadgets. You should ask him. Maybe he will buy them!
:{{DIcon}} I want to buy some medicine...
::'''Wulü:''' Did you get hurt? You don't need to tough it out, why don't you go see [[Koko]] for some medicine?
::'''Wulü:''' Her pharmacy is on the shopping street. Whatever your issue might be, you can always check with her first.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Nothing else.
::'''Wulü:''' Oh, I see. Take your time to explore! We have so many delicious treats and fun activities in Jinzhou. Enjoy your stay!
----
;(During the evening)
:;(Idle)
::'''Doudou:''' Dad, today I also practiced hide-and-seek with Mingming!
::'''Wulü:''' Good, I knew Doudou and Mingming were good kids.
::'''Mingming:''' Do you have any new hiding techniques to teach us?
::'''Wulü:''' Er... I'm still at work. Can you be patient for a little longer?
::'''Doudou:''' Of course! We'll wait patiently for you here, Dad!

:'''Wulü:''' Okay, okay, I'll teach you after work... Oh, sorry, how can I help you?
:{{DIcon}} I'm looking for food...
::'''Wulü:''' If you want a hot meal at this time, Panhua's Restaurant is the place to go!
::'''Wulü:''' After work, I take my kids there too. They love Miss Panhua's dishes and always finish everything!
:{{DIcon}} I'm looking for souvenirs...
::'''Wulü:''' Souvenirs? My kids love that stuff, too. They often visit Ganxue to buy Pioneer Association merchandise.
::'''Wulü:''' Badges, cards, and tickets, and so much more... It never fails to blow me away!
:{{DIcon}} I have some little boxes with me...
::'''Wulü:''' Little box? Oh, you mean a Sonance Casket, right?
::'''Wulü:''' My son mentioned that Uncle Chenpi loves collecting these. If you have any, you can take them to him. He'd love to have them!
:{{DIcon}} I want to buy some medicine...
::'''Wulü:''' Did you get hurt? You don't need to tough it out, why don't you go see Koko for some medicine?
::'''Wulü:''' Her pharmacy is on the shopping street. Whatever your issue might be, you can always check with her first.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Nothing else.
::'''Wulü:''' Oh, I see. Take your time to explore! We have so many delicious treats and fun activities in Jinzhou. Enjoy your stay!
{{Dialogue End}}
